E-402.title: Spindle Thermal Overload & Lubrication Fault
E-402.oem_diagnosis: Spindle temperature sensor exceeds 75°C due to inadequate oil flow or bearing wear.
E-402.oem_procedure:
1. Shut down machine immediately.
2. Flush spindle coolant lines.
3. Replace spindle lubrication pump unit if pressure remains below 2.5 bar.

E-105.title: X-Axis Servo Motor Current Limit Exceeded
E-105.oem_diagnosis: High mechanical resistance on X-axis ball screw or failed drive transistor.
E-105.oem_procedure: Inspect ball screw for debris, re-grease guideways, test servo amplifier drive current.

E-301.title: Through-Spindle Coolant Flow Low
E-301.oem_diagnosis: Coolant intake filter clogged or booster pump failure.
E-301.oem_procedure: Clean 50-micron mesh filter, check pump impeller rotation.

E-402.title: Hydraulic Line Pressure Fluctuation & Cavitation
E-402.oem_diagnosis: Hydraulic main pump cavitation caused by air entrapment or severe fluid viscosity breakdown.
E-402.oem_procedure: Bleed hydraulic circuit valve V3, drain fluid, perform complete pump overhaul.

E-208.title: Proportional Control Valve Position Fault
E-208.oem_diagnosis: Feedback LVDT sensor signal out of calibration range.
E-208.oem_procedure: Recalibrate LVDT zero point, inspect 24V DC solenoid wiring.

E-501.title: MIG Wire Feed Encoder Deviation
E-501.oem_diagnosis: Friction in wire conduit tube or worn drive rollers.
E-501.oem_procedure: Blow out liner with compressed air, replace knurled feed rollers.

E-602.title: Axis 3 Resolver Synchronization Error
E-602.oem_diagnosis: Resolver cable shielding damaged or mechanical backlash in gear reducer.
E-602.oem_procedure: Check EMD calibration tool, re-sync Axis 3 home position.

E-102.title: VFD Inverter Overcurrent Trip
E-102.oem_diagnosis: Conveyor belt mechanical jam or acceleration ramp set too steep.
E-102.oem_procedure: Check drive roller bearings, adjust VFD parameter P1120 acceleration time.
